author: gauntlet
scope: Local owner-bound profiles and Foundation-backed task lifecycle

browser.caveat: Task launch/result/cancellation browser states use labeled response fixtures after actual owner enrollment and scoped profile creation. They do not prove a native task traverses HTTP and Hermes end to end.

native.caveat: Three actual pinned transport measurements passed: positive, hostile tool reply and controlled hanging cancellation. Authorization callback is counted stub transport qualification; real Foundation composition is tested separately. Cancellation fixture releases its upstream explicitly after stop observation: this proves actual settlement/no replay and does not claim instantaneous remote socket abortion. No paid request was made.
